theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.nval_pull {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {G : Type} [TopologicalSpace G] [CommGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] {ι : Type} {U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} {κ : Type} {W : κ → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} (hU : ConnFamily U) (r : κ → ι) (f : (j : κ) → W j ⟶ U (r j)) (c : CechGerbe.TwoCocycle U (contPresheaf X G)) (i j k : κ) (hne : (↑(W i ⊓ W j ⊓ W k)).Nonempty) :
nval (CechGerbe.TwoCocycle.pull r f c).toTwoCochain i j k = nval c.toTwoCochain (r i) (r j) (r k)

nval (ofNval V hV).toTwoCochain i j k = V i j k

theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.class_eq_one_iff_nval {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {G : Type} [TopologicalSpace G] [CommGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] {ι : Type} {U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} (hU : ConnFamily U) (c : CechGerbe.TwoCocycle U (contPresheaf X G)) :
c.class = 1 ↔ ∃ (w : ι → ι → G), ∀ (i j k : ι), (↑(U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k)).Nonempty → nval c.toTwoCochain i j k = w i j * w j k * (w i k)⁻¹

theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.rel_iff_nval {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {G : Type} [TopologicalSpace G] [CommGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] {ι : Type} {U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X} (hU : ConnFamily U) (c₁ c₂ : CechGerbe.TwoCocycle U (contPresheaf X G)) :
c₁.Rel c₂ ↔ ∃ (w : ι → ι → G), ∀ (i j k : ι), (↑(U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k)).Nonempty → nval c₂.toTwoCochain i j k = nval c₁.toTwoCochain i j k * (w i j * w j k * (w i k)⁻¹)
